description: Internal base of the pieces TmGantt is composed of (TmGanttToolbar, TmGanttTree, TmGanttTimeline, TmGanttSidebar), hidden from the editor. All Gantt state stays in TmGantt; a part reads it through Owner and draws its slice of the DOM. A part forwards its events to the owner, and the tree and the timeline skip a render pass in which nothing they draw changed. A host places TmGantt, never a part.

members.name: Owner
members.description: The Gantt this part belongs to. Internal: TmGantt passes itself; a host never sets it.
